note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the printed 38-wire topology and the p.23 rule, not printed. No erratum changes a wire; ER-33 (draw on TOP terminals) is honoured by using Mnt holes only. Free wires are cords 38-41 on M10#3..#6 and 42-45 on M11#2..#5, as in C2/V-EXP12; a drawn end goes in Mnt#1 for cells 1-3 and Mnt#2 for cells 4-9 (Mnt#1 holds the coil feed). Derived case: the tenth form, the diamond 2468, which p.22 prints without a numeral and p.21 makes 0 by elimination (programs.json printedUnprinted). Topology gives D0 for it: relays 3, 4, 5 in, 1, 2, 6 out. Script choices, not printed: numeral 9 first, so the knob leaves the power-on D0 and the diamond run has to travel back to 0 (an assert at 0 without the move would not discriminate); relay states for 9 and the diamond, and the post-release state, are derived. Both runs keep relay 6 out (the knife-edge pull-in seen at numeral 8 in C2/V-EXP12). Hold lengths are script choices; untils allow 15 s for a run rate as slow as 25 rpm (profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5).
